option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom, not a specific disease, and is not directly related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT).

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) are distinct genetic conditions from Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), although both involve vascular malformations.
Vascular malformation of the nose, leading to epistaxis, is a common manifestation of Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT).
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT).
